lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][8C]K"Suponho que sim... [02]Nao eh como se eu tivesse algo melhor [02]a fazer..."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][8C]K"Anyway, we need to[01]be getting to the[01][05][02]Yorae Shrine[06]."

lines.speaker: Nina

lines.text_source: [14][14][12]"Don't get the wrong[01]idea![02]It's not because I[01]enjoy being in this[01]armor or anything!"
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][14][12]"Nao me entenda errado! Nao eh porque eu gosto de estar nessa armadura ou nada assim! [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis defensive about armor; 'Don't get the wrong idea' = ironic deflection; she cares but masks it with sarcasm.

lines.text_source: [14][94][12]"I can't go around[01]borrowing that girl's[01]body forever anyway."
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][94][12]"Nao dah pra ficar tomando emprestado o corpo daquela garota pra sempre."
lines.risk_notes: Deis explaining logistics; 'can't go around borrowing' = casual acknowledgment of necessity.

lines.text_source: [14][94]R"There's not much I[01]can do by myself[01]anyway...[02]I mean, what good's[01]a god without a[01]body, eh?"
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][94]R"Nao tem muito que eu possa fazer sozinha afinal... Quero dizer, pra que serve uma deusa sem corpo, ne? [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis as god without form; 'what good's a god' = rhetorical, sarcastic; not bitter, resigned.

lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][94]R"Eh decisao sua, [04]"
lines.risk_notes: 'It's up to you' with '[04]' placeholder; Deis cedes decision; brief, characteristic of her style.

lines.text_source: [14][14][12]"Well, let's get this[01]show on the road,[01]then![02]You're going to go[01]to the Empire, right?[02]We better get down[01]from this mountain[01]then."
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][14][12]"Bem, vamos botar isso na rua entao! Voces vao ao Imperio, certo? Eh melhor a gente descer dessa montanha entao. [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis proposes action; 'let's get this show on the road' = idiomatic localization (change to 'vamos botar isso na rua'); brief, direct.

lines.text_source: [14][14][12]"Don't worry about[01]Rhem.[02]She's just sleeping,[01]that's all. I must[01]have worn her out.[02]Come on, then, let's[01]go!"
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [14][14][12]"Nao se preocupe com Rhem. Ela esta apenas dormindo, eh tudo. Devil tê-la cansado. Vamos la entao, vamos! [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis about Rhem (host body's original); 'worn her out' = Deis' casual care beneath sarcasm.

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][94]R"Oh...[0B]You're awake,[01]eh?[02]I decided to stick[01]around with them for[01]a while longer.[02]That means I'll need[01]you again. Hope you[01]don't mind."
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][94]R"Ah... Voce acordou, eh? Decidi ficar por aqui com eles um pouco mais. Isso significa que vou precisa de voce de novo. Espero que nao se importe. [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis returns; '[02]' page break preserved; 'I decided to stick around' = understated commitment; 'Hope you don't mind' = sarcastic politeness.

lines.text_source: [0C][02][14][94]R"What're you laughing[01]for!?[02]I didn't come back[01]because I wanted to!"[02][14][FF][FF][14]E
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [0C][02][14][94]R"Por que voce esta rindo!? Nao voltei porque queria! [02][14][FF][FF][14]E"
lines.risk_notes: Deis denies return was voluntary; '[14][FF][FF][14]E' formatting tag at end (speaker change); emotion must be palpable (frustrated but not hostile).

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][94]R"Sigh...[0B]All right,[01]all right...Enough[01]already.[02]Listen to me--from[01]now on, I want you[01]to call me Deis, OK?"
lines.speaker: Deis
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][94]R"Suspiro... Tudo bem, tudo bem... Chega ja. Me ouça -- de agora em diante, quero que voce me chame de Deis, certo? [02]"
lines.risk_notes: Deis insists on name change; 'enough already' = exasperation; 'call me Deis' = formal assertion of identity/separation from host.

lines.text_source: [14][06][08]"Yes, [04][05]."[02][14][FF][FF][14][94]R"What did I just tell[01]you!?[02]Things'll get too[01]confusing if we both[01]use that name.[02]You can have it, all[01]right?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][06][08]"Sim, [04][05]. [02][14][FF][FF][14][94]R"Por que diabos voce nao escutou!? Ficar confuso se usamao ambos aquele nome. Voce pode ficar com ele, certo? [02]"
lines.risk_notes: NPC agrees then gets corrected by Deis; '[14][FF][FF][14]' formatting; dual dialogue; second speaker (Deis) must sound sharply irritable.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"Great and powerful[01]Yorae Dragon![02]If you are looking[01]for the Abbess,[02]she is in her[01]quarters."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"Grande e poderoso Dragao Yorae! Se [02]voce procura ela Abadessa, ela esta [02]em seus aposentos."
lines.risk_notes: NPC addresses Fou-Lu as 'Yorae Dragon' (lore term); formal, respectful register; 'Great and powerful' = localized honorific.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"The Abbess has told[01]me of what happened[01]while I was asleep.[02]Things will be[01]quieter here now...[01]I'll miss my friends."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"A Abadessa me contou do que aconteceu enquanto eu dormia. As coisas serao [02]mais tranquilas aqui agora... Vou sentir falta dos meus amigos."
lines.risk_notes: NPC reflects on loss; 'I'll miss my friends' = emotional but composed; preserve melancholy.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"Even if they are no[01]longer physically[01]with us,[02]the spirits of the[01]people of Chek will[01]remain here forever."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"Mesmo que nao estejam mais fisicamente conosco[02], os espiritos do povo de Chek permanecera aqui para sempre."
lines.risk_notes: NPC speaks of spirits remaining; 'Chek' is place name (no translation); formal, spiritual tone.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"You too have been[01]caught up in the[01]dragon's path...[02]The life stream of[01]The Endless.[02]I pray that the[01]path you walk be[01]a straight one."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"Voce tambem foi apanhado pelo caminho do dragao..[02]. O fluxo de vida dos Eternos. [02]Rogo que o caminho que voce trilhe seja reto."
lines.risk_notes: NPC blessing; 'dragon's path' = lore reference ('The Endless'); 'life stream' = spiritual concept; archaic register required.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"Since it is we who[01]summon the gods to[01]this earth,[02]we of all people[01]know of what awaits[01]us with time."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"Como somos nos que invocamos os deuses a esta terra, de todos [02]nós eh que conhecemos o que nos aguarda com o tempo."
lines.risk_notes: NPC explains summons of gods; formal, slightly archaic; 'we of all people' = understated wisdom.

lines.text_source: [14][0B][0A]"Mighty Deis...[02]I see you have chosen[01]to return to [04][05]'s[01]body...[02]Please forgive me if[01]I was not worthy of[01]you..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][0B][0A]"Poderosa Deis..[02]. Vejo que voce escolheu voltar ao corpo de [04][05]... [02]Por favor, perdoe-me se nao fui digna de voce..."
lines.risk_notes: NPC addresses Deis in armor; '[04][05]' placeholder; 'not worthy' = spiritual humility; formal register.
